svg.title: X — flat mark
svg.desc: X mark as a solid, cel-shaded emblem with an unchanged source silhouette. Font Awesome Free 7.3.1; Fonticons, Inc. (https://fontawesome.com), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Original front path preserved. Illustrated version adds cel-shaded extrusion; flat version is scaled and centered. Colors use the repository palette.
